Name: Eregion Glorfindel Session Drain
Description: R-03 (SEC11): the one right of the session drain - Run Command, to cut the sessions already open on a VM Glorfindel isolates (ss -K, Linux; the command is written in Glorfindel's code, never by the model). Assigned VM by VM, on the enrolled VMs only, never on a resource group: a VM without it is still isolated, and the drain refused is said on the card. Taken out of Eregion Glorfindel Response.
